case_scope: European Union platform work employment presumption and algorithmic management

workplace_power_gate.note: Directive (EU) 2024/2831 creates a strong paper rail, but the operative threshold is Member State transposition by the 2026 deadline and enforcement in actual platform disputes.

platform_algorithmic_management.note: Algorithmic management rights require explainability, human oversight, consultation, data limits, and deactivation remedies that workers can use quickly.

misclassification_risk.note: The employment-presumption architecture must be tested by national implementation and false-self-employment outcomes.

job_switching_claimability.note: Ratings, account portability, suspension/deactivation rules, and data access determine whether platform workers can exit or multi-home without losing accumulated economic position.

wage_theft_and_pay_remedy_access.note: The cube still lacks post-transposition evidence on backpay, reclassification, data access, and deactivation-reversal remedies.

proof_debt: Member State transposition status by December 2026
national enforcement staffing and venue access
worker notice/human-review outcomes for algorithmic decisions

gate_14_workplace_power.why: The Directive is a promising paper rail, but Gate 14 cannot pass before transposition and enforcement outcomes are visible.

gate_11_enforcement.why: Algorithmic and classification rights must become usable appeals, reclassification, and restoration remedies.

evidence_debt_register.question: Member State transposition status by December 2026
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track each Member State transposition measure, effective date, scope, agency/court venue, and worker-notice rule.

evidence_debt_register.question: national enforcement staffing and venue access
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect authority budgets, complaint channels, labor-inspector capacity, and collective-representation access after transposition.

evidence_debt_register.question: algorithmic decision human-review outcomes
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether deactivation, allocation, ratings, surveillance, and pay decisions receive timely human review and reversal remedies.

evidence_debt_register.question: reclassification and backpay outcomes
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track false self-employment findings and whether workers receive retroactive wages, benefits, social contributions, and protections.

evidence_debt_register.question: worker awareness and appeal access
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure take-up, abandonment, language access, retaliation fear, and platform compliance with notice rules.

policy_pathway: Treat the 2026 transposition deadline as a recertification trigger, not a completed reform.
Document national implementation, successful reclassification, timely algorithmic-decision review, and collective enforcement.
